TITLE: RelationVGGT: Visual Geometry Transformers for 3D Spatial Relation Segmentation
AUTHOR: Minsu Kim, Jaesung Choe, Jiwoo Lee, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Seon Joo Kim
ABSTRACT: RelationVGGT addresses relation-guided segmentation across unposed views of a 3D scene. Given a subject mask in one reference image and a textual relation, it identifies the related target in the remaining views without a target category label. The feed-forward model combines semantic and geometry-aware foundation-model features through a subject-conditioned relation transformer, avoiding scene-specific optimization and camera-pose inputs. An automated ScanNet++ annotation pipeline uses vision-language and language models, multi-view agreement, and geometric filtering to generate relation supervision. The approach supports open-vocabulary relational queries and generalization to unseen scenes.
